@graph.description:
Replication of nav2's behavior-tree system test
(nav2_system_tests/src/behavior_tree/test_behavior_tree_node.cpp, main;
nav2_system_tests.csv lines 2-8). Where upstream runs an in-process gtest -- a
BehaviorTreeFactory plus DUMMY action servers (ComputePathToPose, FollowPath, Spin,
Wait, BackUp) with injectable failure/running ranges, ticked by hand -- this campaign
runs the REAL nav2 stack (bt_navigator + planner + controller + behavior_server) with
the stock recovery tree `navigate_to_pose_w_replanning_and_recovery.xml` and drives a
real NavigateToPose goal. The tree's execution is recorded through /behavior_tree_log
and analysed for behavior-tree coverage.

MEANING OF A CELL: one configuration is the runtime analog of one upstream gtest
case. The blackbox scenario cannot inject per-node failure ranges or tick the tree
manually, so only the two END-TO-END outcomes upstream produces are ported:

- bt-all-success  <- TestAllSuccess: a REACHABLE goal (0.0, 2.0). The recovery
  tree's PipelineSequence (ComputePathToPose + FollowPath) succeeds and the tree
  returns SUCCESS. expect_success: true.
- bt-all-failure  <- TestAllFailure: an UNREACHABLE goal (10.0, 10.0, outside the
  map). ComputePathToPose fails, NavigateRecovery fires the recovery subtree
  (GoalUpdated -> RoundRobin: ClearingActions, Spin, Wait, BackUp), the retries
  exhaust, and the tree returns FAILURE. expect_success: false. This is the case
  that ELICITS the recovery nodes -- the BT-coverage cells show Spin/Wait/BackUp
  actually ticking, which a successful run never reaches.

NOT PORTED (whitebox/unit -- see readme.md): the XML-parse and ID-extraction tests
(TestBTXMLFiles, TestWrongBTFormatXML, TestExtractBehaviorTreeID, the duplicate-ID /
unique-ID registration tests, TestSkipFilesWithMissingID), which need in-process
factory parsing with no robot involved, and the dummy-server recovery-LOGIC tests
(TestNavigateSubtreeRecoveries, TestNavigateRecoverySimple, TestNavigateRecoveryComplex,
TestRecoverySubtreeGoalUpdated), which inject per-server failure/running ranges and
mid-tick goal updates that a blackbox scenario cannot express. Their recovery
BEHAVIOUR is the observable bt-all-failure surfaces.

GRADING: the scenario emits `end` only when the navigate action reports
STATUS_SUCCEEDED, so bt-all-success passes and bt-all-failure fails (the expected
upstream verdicts). Behavior-tree coverage is measured per run by
search/bt_coverage.py:BtCoverage against ground truth and summarised in the
analysis_run.ipynb "Behavior-tree nodes and coverage" cells. BtCoverage's goal_x/goal_y
are set to the SUCCESS goal (0.0, 2.0); the bt-all-failure run's `arrived` is 0 by
design (its outcome is the tree FAILURE, not arrival).
